_doc: Seeded variants reviewed by hand and judged NOT to be defects. They are reported separately and left out of the audited score. Each entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

excluded.stack-chan_stack-chan_m5-pantilt__pullup: R8 biases the RS-485 B line of a MAX3485. RS-485 A/B pins are rated for a -7 V to +12 V common-mode range, so biasing to +5 V instead of +3.3 V is not an over-voltage defect.
